reviews.title: Works with older Master cooler240
reviews.comment: Excellent product. Worked with mounting my intel.12k i5 1700 CPU with my mastercooler 240.
reviews.author: Michael Beauchamp

reviews.title: Fits 1700 sockets mobos
reviews.comment: Get this set if you need a replacement kit for intel 1700 socket. works good.
reviews.author: Rodrigo R Knutson

reviews.title: Can be used with CoolerMaster ML240L V2 and Intel 1700
reviews.comment: Cooler Master doesn't provide a retrofit Intel 1700 CPU socket adapter for older models of the ML240L V2.  This adapter can be used together with the pump head brackets provided by Cooler Master to install the pump head on motherboards using the Intel 1700 socket.
reviews.author: MAM

reviews.title: PEERLESS ASSASSIN 120 SE DO NOT BUY
reviews.comment: The GIANT nuts you screw on top of the spacers instead of into them like the stock peerless assassin are too big and have clearance issues with the pipes so I can’t screw it on without damaging the pipes
reviews.author: Alec Warnock

reviews.title: Must have for LGA1700.
reviews.comment: Very easy to install and a must have to replace the old-style lever bar.  This keeps the CPU mounted securely without bending the mother board .
reviews.author: marpuff
